$comment: Which service plans each posture feature needs. Every row names the page it comes from and when it was read. Service plan names must exist in entitlements.json (Microsoft's licensing CSV); a test fails otherwise.

features.name: Every Microsoft 365 tenant
features.note: Security defaults are available for all customers.

features.name: Microsoft Entra ID P1 (Conditional Access)
features.note: Using Conditional Access requires Microsoft Entra ID P1 licences; Business Premium includes it.

features.name: Microsoft Entra ID P2 (risk-based Conditional Access)
features.note: Sign-in risk and user risk policies need Microsoft Entra ID Protection, a P2 feature.

features.name: Microsoft Entra ID P2 (Privileged Identity Management)
features.note: ScubaGear section 7: the PIM policies require a Microsoft Entra ID P2 licence.

features.name: Microsoft Intune Plan 1
features.note: Plan 1 is the base Intune service; compliance policies are part of it.

features.name: SharePoint Online
features.note: External sharing is a SharePoint Online tenant setting; any SharePoint plan has it.

features.name: Defender for Office 365 Plan 1
features.note: Plan 1: Safe Links, Safe Attachments, anti-phishing. Plan 2 includes Plan 1.

features.name: Defender for Office 365 Plan 2
features.note: Plan 2 adds attack simulation training and automated investigation and response.
